model.name: IntelliJ-style 3-way diff/merge editor (resolve OOSH version issue)
model.description: An IntelliJ-style 3-WAY diff/merge editor to resolve the OOSH version issue: left + right (the two compared versions) merged into a center pane, with per-hunk take-over, file selectors (RbFileTree), a git branch/commit chooser, and a swap. Decomposed into R30.6.1-5.
model.tronQuote: > TRON 2026-07-13: build an IntelliJ-style 3-way diff/merge editor to resolve the OOSH version issue. Left + right compared, center merged, per-hunk take-over, file selectors, git branch/commit chooser, swap.

discoverySource.note: Big feature - decomposed into R30.6.1-5 sub-reqs (each its own UC + task). Scenario-first. Architect designs the architecture in parallel; req = sole minter.

model.crossRefNote: 3-way diff/merge editor (R30.6 umbrella) to resolve the OOSH version issue. Class DiffMergeEditor (architect wires).

acceptanceCriteria.text: An IntelliJ-style 3-way diff/merge editor: left + right (compared versions) + center (merged).
It resolves a file version conflict by merging left+right into the center result (the OOSH version issue).
Composed of R30.6.1 (3-way view) + R30.6.2 (file selectors) + R30.6.3 (hunk take-over) + R30.6.4 (git branch/commit chooser) + R30.6.5 (swap).
